name: CEA Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of CEA using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) in serum or plasma samples. The test is used dinically as an aid in the diagnosis and management of cancer patients. For professional and laboratory use only. This test can NOT be used to guide the diagnosis of pair trisomy 21.
